title: Fetch live BTCUSDT data and run complete WFA analysis
objective: Fetch real BTCUSDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance public API, then run walk-forward analysis using both RSI momentum and SMA crossover strategies to validate the end-to-end crypto data pipeline and produce scored evidence.
hypothesis: The Binance fetcher will successfully retrieve OHLCV data, and both strategies will produce measurable out-of-sample results that can be compared. This validates the data pipeline is working for crypto strategies.
dataset_requirements: Live BTCUSDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance (1000 candles)
implementation_steps: Fetch BTCUSDT 1h data from Binance API using binance_fetcher.py and save to workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h.csv

Run WFA analysis with RSI momentum strategy: python3 workspace/harness/wfa_engine.py --csv workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h.csv --strategy workspace.strategies.rsi_momentum --output workspace/results/btc_rsi_wfa --train-size 200 --test-size 50

Run WFA analysis with SMA crossover strategy: python3 workspace/harness/wfa_engine.py --csv workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h.csv --strategy workspace.strategies.sma_cross --output workspace/results/btc_sma_wfa --train-size 200 --test-size 50
Compare results and generate summary report in workspace/results/btc_comparison/report.json

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Binance data fetched successfully (CSV exists with >500 rows), both WFA reports generated with valid out_of_sample metrics

fallback_if_blocked: Verify CSV has correct OHLCV format
Check WFA engine handles real market data correctly
notes: This validates the core crypto data pipeline end-to-end
Compares momentum (RSI) vs trend-following (SMA) on real BTC data
First real evidence for crypto strategies in the factory
